about.title: Khiva State Museum-Reserve – Historical Heritage Since 1970
about.text:
Khiva State Museum-Reserve (established in 1970) is a major cultural and educational center dedicated to preserving and promoting the rich historical heritage of Khiva and its surroundings.

The museum houses a rich collection showcasing Khiva's ancient art, architecture, and traditional lifestyle. Beyond conserving and preserving historical monuments, it plays a key role in conducting scientific research and introducing the region's history to locals and tourists.

collections.title: Cultural Heritage Collection of Khorezm
collections.text: The rich collection of the Khiva State Museum-Reserve features unique artifacts preserved through the centuries. Discover the history and culture of the Khorezmian people through traditional ceramics, national attire, and ancient weaponry.
